fields.label: User
fields.description: Frappe user these settings belong to (one row per user).

fields.label: Assistant Persona
fields.description: Which persona voice this user chats with: Jarvis (default) or Jara (calmer, more jovial). Voice only - same tools, permissions, and behaviour.

fields.label: Business Greeting State
fields.description: Merged from Jarvis User Preference. Blank = eligible for the every-third-new-chat greeting; Dismissed = permanent 'Don't ask again' (DB-only so cache flushes can't resurrect it). Permlevel 1: server-owned app state, written only by jarvis.chat.greeting via raw db calls that bypass permlevel — a Jarvis User can read but never write it through a generic document update.

fields.label: Business Greeting Chat Count
fields.description: Merged from Jarvis User Preference. Counts genuinely-new chats; drives the multiple-of-3 greeting cadence. Permlevel 1: server-owned (jarvis.chat.greeting.increment_new_chat_count), read-only to a Jarvis User.

fields.label: Business Greeting Hidden At Count
fields.description: Merged from Jarvis User Preference. Chat count at which the card was last 'Maybe later'-ed; keeps a refresh from re-showing it. Permlevel 1: server-owned (jarvis.chat.greeting), read-only to a Jarvis User.

fields.label: Home Intro Seen Version
fields.description: Highest chat-home introduction version this user has been shown (0 = never). Monotonic; only jarvis.chat.user_settings_api.mark_home_intro_seen writes it (raw SQL, permlevel-bypassing). Permlevel 1: a Jarvis User can read this but a generic owner-level document update CANNOT write it, so a client can neither invent a future version nor mute the next introduction. Bumping HOME_INTRO_VERSION re-shows the introduction once.

fields.label: Home Intro Seen At
fields.description: When home_intro_seen_version was last advanced. Permlevel 1: server-owned, read-only to a Jarvis User.

fields.label: Monthly Token Limit
fields.description: Per-user monthly token cap. 0 = unlimited. Admins only.

fields.label: Usage Month
fields.description: Month (YYYY-MM) the month_* counters currently accumulate into.

fields.label: Last Synced At
fields.description: When admin_sync_usage last refreshed per-session snapshots.

fields.label: Per-Model Usage
fields.description: Per-model month-to-date token counters + per-model caps. Written only by server code (jarvis.chat.usage). 0 cap = unlimited. Bench keeps the current month only; admin persists history from the daily push.
